description: Deterministic rulebook for the Headliner deal check. Every threshold that touches money lives here, never in a prompt.

evidence.affinityMetric: Mean Qloo heatmap affinity_rank across the city's geohash cells (0 to 1). Raw affinity is rescaled per response (mean 0.500 in every city) and is not used.
evidence.affinityCalibration: Cut-offs are the tertiles of 75 act-city pairs (15 real acts x Austin, Chicago, Atlanta, Denver, Los Angeles) measured 2026-10-19 with pnpm calibrate: p33 0.614, median 0.756, p67 0.883. Stand-up comics scored 0.88-0.98 in every city, so for them the city comparison carries more information than the label.

sponsorActivationUsd.label: Illustrative local activation range. Not a quote.

changelog.change: Added maxTicketRaisePct (0.35): the ticket-price fix is offered only when a raise of at most 35% over the offered price brings break-even inside the warning line. Seed offers needing more (57% to 165%) get no price fix.
Affinity read from affinity_rank instead of the per-response rescaled affinity; low/strong cut-offs recalibrated from 0.30/0.60 to measured tertiles 0.61/0.88.
First rulebook, written before the Qloo key arrived; affinity cut-offs were placeholders.
